For this year’s Trails and Sails, we are offering our Women’s History Tour! From the Indigenous women who worked the land to our organization’s founder, women have always been a part of the Turner-Ingersoll Mansion’s history, but not always given the spotlight they deserve. The House of the Seven Gables has created a Women’s History Tour to focus, in-depth, on the many women who have lived and labored in the Mansion. This event is free, but registration is required. © 2026 The House of the Seven Gables. Website designed and developed by
